sources.snippet: Overview VoxCPM-0.5B is a tokenizer-free Text-to-Speech model developed by openbmb that generates speech directly from continuous representations rather than discrete tokens. The model uses an end-to-end diffusion autoregressive architecture built on the MiniCPM-4 backbone with 0.5 billion parameters, trained on 1.8 million hours of bilingual speech data. sources.title: VoxCPM-0.5B · Models
sources.snippet: VoxCPM is a novel tokenizer-free Text-to-Speech (TTS) system that redefines realism in speech synthesis. By modeling speech in a continuous space, it overcomes the limitations of discrete tokenization and enables two flagship capabilities: context-aware speech generation and true-to-life zero-shot voice cloning.
